purpose: Bounded section-level RST-inspired editorial check, not a formal EDU annotation, new research method, hypothesis test or causal graph.

HSM-SDE.scope: ordinary method family, not all-terrain; other Full controls retain their numbered identities

RDM-SDE.scope: one-pass residual-direction grouping, not conventional EM-fitted GMM; within the SDE family

conclusions.claim: CV has lower ES at saved 1/5-minute targets; HSM-SDE has lower ES at 15/30 minutes.
conclusions.qualification: Conditional descriptive utility relative to deterministic CV, not necessity of complex SDE or a precise crossover time.

conclusions.claim: RDM-SDE has lower saved mean ES and final mean-position error; residual-direction grouping is promising but not confirmed superior.
conclusions.qualification: Paired ES interval [-21.22,16.33] includes zero; label mismatch limits attribution; no per-horizon ES claim from an aggregate.

conclusions.claim: 120/300-second observation-interval mean ES changes are larger than examined training/adaptation changes against respective controls; additional training/adaptation complexity shows no clear added ES benefit.
conclusions.qualification: Not a direct cross-class significance test, causal importance ranking or proof that learning is unnecessary. dt is not integration step; dt300 increases FDE.

conclusions.claim: The procedure generates probabilistic forecasts, but reliable long-horizon disks are not established; HSM-SDE 30-minute nominal 90% coverage is 46.52%.
conclusions.qualification: No new calibration test, radius adjustment or operational guarantee; coverage and area must be read together.

relations.role: Defines what was forecast and how; equations are not empirical performance evidence.
Defines score, location, region and qualification so comparisons have a common meaning.
Describes retrospective selection, not participant independence or population representativeness.
Separate findings support bounded conclusions; repeated views are not independent replications.
Restricts generalisation, structural superiority and reliability; terrain inference remains unavailable.
Four answer groups in the same order, not a causal chain between diagnostic outcomes.
